name: horse_h1
title: Horses, concept round H1: the pony's head before (classic) beside two reworked heads on an arched, maned neck (h1 built, h2 sculpted: now the game's)
_doc: Dominic (2026-10-13): "horses heads need a real re-work". h1 and h2 (data/later/horses.json; scenes/art_pixel/unit_models.gd 'The reworked horse'; tools/blender/horse.py) share the new neck (deep at the base, arched along the crest, a mane from the poll into the withers, narrowing to the throat latch and running into the head, joined without a line), the small upright ears, the forelock and the bridle; h1's head is built from shapes, h2's is one sculpted surface. UnitModels.pony_look switches the game's pony. Notes: docs/concepts/horses/README.md.
